body: Q: Since I've met you I'm experiencing atremendous upheaval. A: Isn't it aglorious upheaval? Q; It feels heartbreaking. A; Why? Q: It's the feeling of my heart opening. A: Do you feel passionate love? Q: Ifeel apassionate hurt, apassionate ache. Ifeel an aloneness that seems very profound. It goes beyond childhood, beyond mother or father... A: The profound aloneness that you are feeling is none other than the echo of the Absolute. The absolute truth is —there is no other. Do you understand? There is no other! With this realization one can experience aprofound aloneness. This profound aloneness is simply the truth of there being no other. Do you understand? Q: Yes. Thank you. 1 7 7
